missionsCreate.title: Заяви транспорт
missionsCreate.introShort: Packed Производствена партида + Ферма pickup адрес.
missionsCreate.intro: Use when a Партида is ready to leave the Ферма.
missionsCreate.workflowStep1: 1) Report жътва — the team sees your plan (dates, channel, expected количество).
missionsCreate.workflowStep2: 2) They confirm what to prepare and coordinate with you (admin "План за жътваs" + бележки to you in process).

missionsCreate.opsRouteBoxBody: You only share Ферма pickup details here. BioVera operations assigns the превозвач and enters the full drop-off for шофьори.
missionsCreate.noBatchesBody: No packed Производствена партида yet. Finish опаковане and съответствие first.
missionsCreate.locationHintDenied: Разрешете местоположението или въведете GPS ръчно.
missionsCreate.pickupCoordsFreedomNote: Pickup GPS can be the Ферма gate or yard — you do not need to be there when you submit. The server only checks that coordinates are valid numbers, not that you are inside the Парцел map.
missionsCreate.whereItGoes: Where it goes (logistics and шофьори need this). Use the same city име on each Курс you want to combine on one truck.
missionsCreate.packagingComplianceBodyShort: Опаковане снимки and label roll for this Производствена партида.
missionsCreate.packagingComplianceWhy: "Quality confirmed" here means your quality entry for the batch is done — it is separate from packing proof for transport. To request a truck the server also requires the three Bio Vera packing photos plus one verified label roll tied to this batch (material-control rule).

missionsCreate.packagingComplianceUnchecked: Опаковане status not потвърден — open съответствие if send fails.
